semantics: All complete feasible goal-ending destination sequences, including departures and revisits. Goal is not absorbing.
method: Exhaustive bounded layered dynamic path count, capped at two per node/fuel/move state. Counts 0,1,2 mean zero, exactly one, at least two distinct sequences.

minimal_metaprobe_results.failure_of_first_arrival_only: First arrival has one length1 sequence, but two complete length3 sequences depart and revisit goal.
